app.title: C++ Insights – See your source code with the eyes of a Compiler
app.author: rramadass
app.description: A Rust-based command line tool that generates annotated C++ source code by leveraging compiler internals, enabling developers to visualize compiler diagnostics, transformations, and optimizations inline with the original code.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `cargo build --release` to produce the binary.
Compile a simple C++ hello‑world program with `cppinsights` and check that the output contains annotated compiler warnings or transformations.
Measure execution time on a 10‑kB C++ file and ensure it completes under 5 seconds.
Run `cppinsights` on a sample project with multiple files and confirm that diagnostics are aggregated correctly.
